title: Strong Girl Bong-soon
hook: How does Strong Girl Bong-soon end? The kidnapper Kim Jang-hyun caught, the proposal, and the twin daughters, explained in full.

sections.heading: Catching the serial kidnapper
sections.body: The central thriller engine of the series is the string of abductions targeting young women in Dobong-dong, including Do Bong-soon's best friend. The culprit is revealed to be Kim Jang-hyun, an unassuming neighbourhood figure who turns out to be the true perpetrator behind the serial kidnappings. Bong-soon, born with superhuman strength, makes catching him a personal mission. The case is resolved when Jang-hyun is finally taken into custody, removing the menace that has hung over the district and over Bong-soon's loved ones. With the kidnapper behind bars, the show clears the way for its romantic and comedic threads to land their conclusions.

sections.heading: Jang-hyun's punishment
sections.body: The series does not leave the villain ambiguous. Kim Jang-hyun is arrested and sentenced to life imprisonment for murder and kidnapping, with no realistic prospect of release. The closing stretch underlines that he is locked away in isolation, and the narrative leaves him to deteriorate mentally in confinement, stripped of the power he once held over his victims. By giving him a definitive, severe sentence rather than an open ending, the show closes the criminal arc cleanly so the emotional focus can shift entirely to Bong-soon and the people she protects.

sections.heading: Min-hyuk's proposal
sections.body: On the romance side, Bong-soon ends up with Ahn Min-hyuk, the wealthy company heir who hired her as a bodyguard and whose feelings for her deepen across the series, eclipsing her early crush on police officer In Guk-doo. With the danger past, Min-hyuk takes the initiative to track down Bong-soon's runaway father. When he finds him, he persuades the father to come home by formally asking for permission to marry Bong-soon, stating plainly that he wants to marry her. The gesture ties together the family reconciliation and the central love story in one move, securing the father's blessing.

sections.heading: Marriage and the twins
sections.body: The finale carries the couple into married life and a happy domestic future. Bong-soon and Min-hyuk wed, and the show then leaps ahead to show them raising twin daughters who have plainly inherited their mother's enormous strength. The babies are depicted leaving a trail of bumps and bruises on their doting gangster caretakers and on their father, a comic flourish, while Bong-soon continues using her gift to protect others. It is an unambiguously upbeat send-off: villain imprisoned, family healed, marriage settled and a new generation of mighty women already making their presence felt.

final_image: The series settles on domestic bliss as Bong-soon and Min-hyuk raise their super-strong twin daughters, the girls comically overpowering everyone around them while their mother keeps watch over the neighbourhood.

lingering_questions.q: Who does Do Bong-soon end up with?
lingering_questions.a: She ends up with Ahn Min-hyuk, the company heir she works for as a bodyguard. Their relationship grows over the series past her initial crush on officer In Guk-doo, and Min-hyuk proposes after asking her father's permission, leading to their marriage.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to the kidnapper Kim Jang-hyun?
lingering_questions.a: He is arrested and sentenced to life imprisonment for murder and kidnapping, with no chance of release. The finale shows him isolated in prison, deteriorating mentally, his threat to Bong-soon and the district permanently neutralised.
